verdict.rationale: Apify documents an official MCP server enabling AI agents/LLMs to discover and use Actors, confirmed both in docs and via a dedicated probe hit at docs.apify.com/platform/integrations/mcp. Apify's product role is a platform/marketplace (not itself an agent), so shipping an MCP server is a valid applicable axis and is fulfilled. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server actually working with agents, and more detail on setup/auth specifics beyond the docs snippet.
